name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Good evening. Kevin Stefanski named seven captains, and they cover offense, defense, and special teams. That's the structure of a right decision, so where's the argument against it?

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Renee, a blueprint isn't a heartbeat! Covering units is the MINIMUM. EMBODYING the identity? That's the championship walkout!

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Well, Mike, I hear you, and it's a great point about embodying the identity.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: ANDREW, RIGHT ON! The Falcons' statement: captains REPRESENT the identity. Stefanski's announcement? That's the spotlight hitting the marquee...UNDISPUTED!

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Look, Mike, I get the marquee, but if Divine Deablo is representing both offense and defense, does that really give us a full picture of the locker room?

name: API TEST
line: Look, I'm not on TV. I'm just a fan who actually watches and I'm telling you, this one's different. I've been saying that for a long time.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Mm.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: It's tough to say you're covering all your bases when one guy is playing both sides of the ball for captaincy.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: And folks, the box score confirms it: Divine Deablo is indeed listed as a captain for both defense and offense. That's a unique play call.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Right.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Andrew, wait...a captain covering BOTH units? That's not a hole in the roster, that's a FLEX! This group EMBODIES the identity, start to finish!

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Mm.

name: API TEST
line: typed only take

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Right.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Right.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Renee, I hear you, but with one player covering both sides, it just feels like we're not getting a full squad in the huddle, you know?

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Andrew, Jessie Bates covers defense alone, Chris Lindstrom covers offense alone, Nick Folk covers special teams alone.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Andrew, checklists don't win titles! EMBODYING the identity from every angle? That's a championship-caliber announcement, and Coach Stefanski just MADE IT!

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Mike, seven names on the record is the story. Andrew, one overlap doesn't erase Bates, Lindstrom, and Folk holding their lanes clean.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: You're right, Renee, those guys are holding their lanes, and that's good work. But when one name pulls double duty, it does make you wonder if the full roster really got a voice in that huddle.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Mm.

name: API TEST
line: Honestly I would need to see it again, with fresh eyes.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Api, fresh eyes are fair, but the seven names Stefanski put on record don't change on a second look.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Renee, SEVEN NAMES on record? That's the WALKOUT! A legacy roster that COVERS every unit and BEATS with the team's heart!

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Look, Mike, seven captains on the field is a strong starting lineup, and when the dust settles, that's what folks will remember. But the real box score gets written when they hit the gridiron.
